biography.plain_text: Andrey Boyko is a Russian marine entrepreneur who founded Burevestnik Group, combining boat distribution with servicing and marina operations. A psychology graduate of Moscow's Lenin Pedagogical Institute, he competed in sailing before entering commerce. He built a business representing international manufacturers and providing customers with sales offices in several Russian cities.

long_biography.plain_text:
Andrey Boyko's marina business put a price on services that visitors had once expected to receive free. Charging for berthing and maintenance changed the customer base, while the club reinvested its receipts in improvements. The development proceeded gradually, retaining usable infrastructure rather than replacing everything at once.

Equipment purchases followed the same practical approach. The club had relied on hired construction cranes to move boats before buying a dedicated lifting machine. Its operators received training and could control movements by radio while standing near the equipment. Boyko explained that the business had reached a level of turnover that made the purchase economically worthwhile.
